An entry is only valid with a non-empty `reason` — diff-pages.mjs throws otherwise. `pages` is a page path, an array of them, or "*". `hunk` is the canonical diff text of the divergence, `-` lines from the baseline and `+` lines from the build, trimmed. Phases 1-4 must reach zero divergences with this list EMPTY; phase 5 adds one entry per deliberate improvement, each in its own commit.

entries.note: The theme switcher. Sits to the left of the language switcher and is b
entries.hunk:
-<!--Temaväxlaren. Ligger till vänster om språkväljaren och är byggd likadant, men som <button>: inget navigeras till, och knappen hamnar därmed utanför stickyNavbars "li a". Ligger före språkväljaren i markupen just för att den ligger till vänster om den på skärmen. Båda är absolutpositionerade i den breda menyn, så ordningen här syns inte — men den styr tabbordningen, och omvänd ordning gav globen fokus före temaknappen fast temaknappen står först.-->
+<!--The theme switcher. Sits to the left of the language switcher and is built the same way, but as a <button>: nothing is navigated to, which also keeps it outside stickyNavbar's "li a". It comes before the language switcher in the markup precisely because it sits to the left of it on screen. Both are absolutely positioned in the wide menu, so the order here is invisible — but it drives the tab order, and the reverse order gave the globe focus before the theme button even though the theme button comes first.-->

entries.note: img alt="Total Digital" height="122" id="banner-logo" src="../im
entries.hunk: - +
entries.reason: Deliberate fix, sanctioned by the migration plan's traps checklist item 10: the about pages' logo tags were missing width/height while all 16 other pages carry width="412" height="122". Templating the header once makes the omission impossible to keep, and adding the intrinsic size removes layout shift. Same image, same rendered size — the attributes only tell the browser the aspect ratio up front.
